SVC_UART.name: ELM327 UART
SVC_UART.description: Vendor transparent serial port. Not a Bluetooth SIG service. CEVA ads list 4353 instead; the 66:1E modules advertise this UUID.

CHR_NOTIFY.name: UART from adapter
CHR_NOTIFY.description: Notify only. ASCII ELM327 replies. Lines end with CR. The prompt is '>'. Subscribe before writing FFF2.

CHR_WRITE.name: UART to adapter
CHR_WRITE.description: Write and write without response. One ASCII ELM327 command plus CR (0x0D).
